Maria: Quick reminder — Partner QuickLab offsite next Tue. We're running three 45m satellite mini-workshops with EdgeLabs + NovaCloud. Need confirmation on demo kit owners, swag handoff plan, and a short run-of-show. Who can own kit packing and courier?

Dan: I'll own packing. Can someone confirm final kit list?

Leo: Sending updated kit list — small servers, router, HDMI, power strips. Also 1x demo laptop per station.

Maria: Pasting kit + swag checklist for visibility:

```
Kit A (x3)
- 1x rtx-demo box
- 1x mini router
- 1x usb-c power brick
- 1x HDMI cable
- 1x laptop (loaner)
Swag pack (per attendee)
- 1 sticker sheet
- 1 postcard
- 1 quick-start guide
- 1 promo code card
```

Ash: We need 120 attendee swag packs. Shipping cutoff Fri COB. Who can confirm courier & address to partner?

Julia: I'll handle courier. Can we do UPS express or does the venue offer partner pickup? Partner contact is Priya @EdgeLabs (priya@edgelabs.com). Note: customs form required for EU kits.

ops-bot: Reminder: create tracking spreadsheet — https://short.link/tracking (added to #partnerships-ops)

Dan: Can do packing by Thu, will drop to Julia on Fri morning. I'll log serials in the sheet.

Maria: Run-of-show (draft): 09:00 arrival, 09:30 install & AV check, 10:00 session 1 (45m), 11:00 swap, 11:15 session 2 (45m), 12:15 lunch, 13:15 session 3 (45m), 15:15 teardown. Need AV contact and on-site point for partner.

Leo: Also add fallback demo: bring a pre-quantized local image with the model and a simple script. If cloud marketplace image > latency or fails, we can switch in ~3m. I'll prep docker image `redwood/quicklab-fallback:latest` and a run script.

Ash: On swag: can we include a small foam mousepad? small cost bump but higher perceived value. Budget ok?

Julia: Budget ok for 120 pads, but increases courier weight class — need exact weight to confirm rate. I'll estimate and confirm before booking.

Maria: Action items recap: Dan = pack & label + serials; Julia = book courier, ship, and track; Leo = build fallback image & test; Ash = finalize swag and counts; Maria = finalize run-of-show, AV contact, and send to partners by Wed EOD. :thumbsup: 

Priya (EdgeLabs): Thanks — we'll confirm venue AV contact and provide customs EIN by Thu. We'll also plan to have one partner tech onsite to help with demo swaps.

Maria: Great, looping in ops email and adding calendar invite now. If anyone needs to change ownership, shout here.
